Maria: Quick RFC follow-up: need to lock smoothing/decay semantics and what we return to clients on 429s before canary. Short notes + decisions?

Arun: Quick recap?

Maria: Two parts: (1) credit recovery smoothing (how penalties decay) (2) client hints in 429 so SDKs back off gracefully.

Priya: For smoothing: leaning to leaky-bucket accounting with exponential decay on penalty multiplier (configurable half-life by tier). Gives gradual recovery vs abrupt window restore.

Arun: Sliding window is simpler though. Any sim results?

Maria: Spike will run both. Early sims show exponential avoids oscillation for sparse traffic; sliding window recovers faster for steady low-rate bursts. We'll pick defaults per tenant class.

Priya: Client hints: fields we should include? retry_after, tokens_granted, penalty_score, sample_rate, and tokens_remaining (masked or rounded).

Maria: Proposed 429 body (advisory): { code: "quota_exceeded", tokens_remaining: "<10", retry_after_seconds: 8, penalty_score: 0.67, tokens_granted: 0, sample_rate: 0.001 } Masking controlled by tenant policy.

Arun: Consider soft-deny (grant a few tokens) vs hard-deny. Soft-deny allows degraded flows. Need eligibility heuristics to avoid gaming.

Priya: Soft-deny only when penalty_score under threshold and cache indicates transient spike. Hard-deny when sustained or high penalty. SDKs treat tokens_granted>0 as allowed degraded path.

sre-bot: Ops items: log penalty transitions, add metrics: deny-rate-by-penalty-band, soft-vs-hard-deny ratio, time-to-recover P50/P90. Add circuit-breaker: if soft-deny fraction >30% for 5m, revert region to local-admit.

Maria: Sampling: adaptive sampling for denials (base_rate + scale*log(tenant_qps)) capped per-tenant. Include sample_rate in 429 so SDKs can opt into debug telemetry. Ensure PII scrubbing before persistence.

Arun: Privacy: tenant customers may not want exact tokens_remaining exposed. Add mask-by-policy option returning buckets like "<10" or "<100". SDK maps those to backoff heuristics.

Priya: Open RFC questions to resolve before canary: default half-life values per tier, token rounding scheme, soft-deny eligibility rules, adaptive sampling params, retention policy for sampled traces.

Maria: Action items: Arun will run decay parameter sweeps in sim; Priya will draft SDK hint handling and masking; I'll add these to the RFC checklist and update the runbook notes. Tagging @eng-sre for ops review.

sre-bot: Reminder: health checks, per-node admit latency histograms, and runbook playbook required before rollout.

Maria: Thanks all, small sync after spike results.
